The Plus-One Pact: Witness Number Two
Four days of fake dating. Rule one: no fake future. Then he tells the whole family “maybe.”
Two wedding guests fake-date to dodge a matchmaking aunt. One of them is moving on Monday. The other thought he was staying.

Nico is emceeing his sister's four-day wedding; Jamie is the groom's old roommate and the second witness on the license. To survive Aunt Rosa, they fake-date under three rules written on the back of a place card. Jamie starts a new job two thousand miles away on Monday and hasn't said so, and Nico keeps promising a future that isn't his to promise. You decide when Jamie tells the truth and what the two of them make of it.
